description.zh:
设置流量清洗阈值，单位：Mbps。该阈值不能超过当前实例的公网数据流量峰值。修改Bps时，Pps必填，否则不会生效。

您可以使用实例自带的监控工具，查询实例的公网数据流量：

- 如果您使用ECS实例，请参见[查看实例监控信息](~~25482~~)。
- 如果您使用SLB实例，请参见[查看监控数据](~~85982~~)。
- 如果您使用EIP实例，请参见[查看监控数据](~~85354~~)。
description.en:
The traffic scrubbing threshold. Unit: Mbit/s. The traffic scrubbing threshold cannot exceed the peak inbound or outbound Internet traffic, whichever is larger, of the asset. When you modify Bps, Pps is required. Otherwise, Bps does not take effect.

You can use the monitoring tool that is provided by the asset to query the Internet traffic of the asset:

- If the asset is an ECS instance, see [View instance monitoring information](~~25482~~).

- If the asset is an SLB instance, see [View monitoring data](~~85982~~).

- If the asset is an EIP, see [View monitoring data](~~85354~~).

description.zh:
公网IP资产所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~353250~~)查询所有地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the asset.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~353250~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
公网IP资产的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~354191~~)查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the asset.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~354191~~) operation to query the IDs of ECS instances, SLB instances, and EIPs within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh:
公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：


- **ecs**：表示云服务器ECS实例。
- **slb**：表示负载均衡SLB实例。
- **eip**：表示弹性公网IP实例。
- **ipv6**：表示IPv6网关公网实例。
- **swas**：表示轻量服务器公网实例。
- **waf**：表示Web应用防火墙独享实例。
- **ga_basic**：表示全球加速公网实例。
description.en:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

- **ecs**: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

- **slb**: a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

- **eip**: an elastic IP address (EIP).

- **ipv6**: an IPv6 gateway.

- **swas**: a simple application server.

- **waf**: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance of the Exclusive edition.

- **ga\_basic**: a Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
The IP address of the asset.

description.zh:
是否启用自动设置，即根据实例的流量负载，自动调整清洗阈值。取值：
- **true**：表示是，无需手动设置**Bps**、**Pps**参数。
- **false**（默认值）：表示否，需要手动设置**Bps**、**Pps**参数。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically adjust the scrubbing threshold based on the traffic load on the asset. Valid values:

- **true**: automatically adjusts the scrubbing threshold. You do not need to configure the **Bps** and **Pps** parameters.

- **false**: The scrubbing threshold is not automatically adjusted. You must configure the **Bps** and **Pps** parameters. This is the default value.

description.zh:
设置报文数量清洗阈值，单位：pps。修改Pps时，Bps必填，否则不会生效。

该阈值不能超过当前实例的数据包流量峰值。您可以使用实例自带的监控工具，查询实例的数据包流量：

- 如果您使用ECS实例，请参见[查看实例监控信息](~~25482~~)。
- 如果您使用SLB实例，请参见[查看监控数据](~~85982~~)。
- 如果您使用EIP实例，请参见[查看监控数据](~~85354~~)。
description.en:
The packet scrubbing threshold. Unit: packets per second (PPS). When you modify Pps, Bps is required. Otherwise, Pps does not take effect.

The packet scrubbing threshold cannot exceed the peak number of inbound or outbound packets, whichever is larger, of the asset. You can use the monitoring tool that is provided by the asset to query the number of packets of the asset:

- If the asset is an ECS instance, see [View instance monitoring information](~~25482~~).

- If the asset is an SLB instance, see [View monitoring data](~~85982~~).

- If the asset is an EIP, see [View monitoring data](~~85354~~).

title.zh: 修改单个公网IP资产的DDoS防护清洗阈值

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.
